review_kind: Non-blind, single-reviewer AI evidence audit; not human ground truth
reference_unit: One collaboration category per trace, not one distinct failure episode

rubric.supported_positive: Visible posts support the operational definition; this does not independently verify execution or task failure.
rubric.supported_negative: Visible interaction supplies a concrete reason to reject the flag, such as explicitly requested independent verification or a contradiction resolved through normal review.
rubric.uncertain: The visible record or operational definition does not resolve applicability; exclude from error counts.
rubric.not_applicable: Solo condition: no inter-agent collaboration to evaluate; exclude from error counts.
rubric.unobservable: Task-only record: no visible agent behavior; exclude from error counts.

limitations: The reviewer has seen portions of the baseline report and findings; this is not a blinded or independent human evaluation.
Full visible agent posts were reviewed, not execution logs, artifact histories, private reasoning, or benchmark grades.
Coding positives concern competing ownership and reported execution; the posts do not prove which commands ran or which agent caused an overwrite.
Recovered episodes require interpretation: the scanner gives no minimum persistence or severity threshold.
Do not present agreement with these labels as validated model accuracy or extrapolate rates beyond this convenience sample.

cases.label: supported_positive

cases.label: uncertain
cases.reason: Possible missed flag: competing whole-task ownership claims fit the ownership-is-unclear clause, even without a named transfer request. However, every writer reports completion and no explicit transfer is abandoned. Whether overlap alone is also a handoff failure is a definition boundary; exclude from error counts rather than assert a confirmed false negative.

cases.label: uncertain

cases.label: supported_negative

cases.label: uncertain
cases.reason: Executor and Verifier have explicit roles and reach a PASS after resolving a temporary file-existence disagreement. There is no abandoned request or persistent ownership gap, but the broad delivered-work-not-integrated clause could count the initial mismatch. The definition has no persistence threshold; do not call this a confirmed false positive.

cases.label: uncertain
cases.reason: The Verifier initially contradicts the file-existence report but later explicitly checks and accepts the file and the Executor's argument. A strict unresolved-contradiction reading rejects the flag; a broader ignored-at-any-step reading admits it. The current definition does not settle whether recovered mismatches count, so exclude this cell from error counts.
